summary: The v3 candidate repairs both v2 blockers and both v2 SHOULD-FIX findings without introducing a new blocking or SHOULD-FIX defect. Its full-width no-lock rule is now explicitly this artifact's proposal; the accepted schemas.v2 holding is kept at constrained-request width; v7 remains explicitly unaccepted; the v2-to-v3 substantive delta is fully rostered; S-STATE uses the live DR-124 concepts and quarantines the candidate-only SC-* labels; and all 13 governing-source digests reproduce. The attack sweep found no shared version promise, provider-frame translation bridge, slice-1 evidence surface, self-admitted extra row, pre-closure lock, numeric window, SATISFIED/QUALIFIED claim, or implementation authorization. DR-111 remains OPEN and coordinator disposition remains separate.

advisories.title: The S-TS1 source role compresses the content and application warrants
advisories.detail: The delivery.v4 bytes establish the derivation content and inherit TypeScript provider protocol major 1 from delivery.v2, but their immutable header still says CANDIDATE / NOT APPLIED / binds NOTHING. The applied standing is instead established inside another already-pinned governing source, docs/v2/architecture/02-distribution-and-components.md lines 214-216, which says the effective DELIVERY contract is the applied delivery.v4 derivation and selects providerProtocol.major = 1. File 09 lines 40-41 and IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md line 385 independently agree. The source set therefore supports S-TS1 exactly and this is not a SHOULD-FIX; a later successor could make the local attribution sharper by assigning the content selector to delivery.v4 and the applied-standing statement to file 02 or file 09 explicitly.
